author: Yffe
content:
Fixer plan (#261): root cause is the builder-era `if not design or not pattern: continue` in load_doc_files (tooling/doc-drift.py L248-249) — a per-entry fail-open that silently drops a [[route]] entry missing a required field, shrinking the checked-doc set while the gate stays green. The #260 isinstance guards reject only present-but-wrong-type; None (missing key) and "" (empty string) fall through to the continue.

Authority: spec-routes.toml schema header marks BOTH crate_pattern and design "# required"; .design/tooling/doc-drift-tripwire.md REQ-1 (checked set = exactly the deduplicated design fields), REQ-5, REQ-8 (no grandfathering), REQ-9 (never exit 0 without checking all docs). An entry missing/empty in either required field is WRONG-SHAPED -> route it through the #260 EnvironmentError3 class -> exit 3, naming the entry index and the missing/empty field. This subsumes the critic's MISSING-PIN reading and the design-missing "acceptable" case: the schema says required, so reject uniformly. The continue dies.

Fix (single file tooling/doc-drift.py): in the per-entry loop, after the type guards, raise EnvironmentError3 when design or crate_pattern is missing or empty, naming entry #i and the field. Remove the now-unreachable continue. Composes after the #259 zero-routes guard and #260 isinstance guards.

Ungate test_c3; tighten its assertion to exactly exit 3 (the implemented-and-spec'd class) since the fix produces 3. Gauntlet: python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v (expect 13 run / 0 skipped / 0 failed); live tree exit 1; git diff scripts/audit.sh empty.
